comments.text: park pulse should populate the little ui panel that says orbit and that panel should be renamed park pulse and should scroll in active park status guest ride entity event metrics throughout the park and common thoughts.

add a collective guests thoughts sesction in the main ui with emoji to track the most common thoughts and point out the most unhappy guests. it should also detail out what the park currently needs to succeed.
when toggling above ground below ground the ground should show black and whats under the earth.

hovering over guest should tell what they are thinking doing holding inventory a descriptive position name not a coordinate, don't need to see template and should show current happiness and have plety of logos.

make there be male female kids and pets that free roam loosly follow owners and have a leash mode too if they misbehave.  make all character models proportional and very graphically detailed. women should look difffernt than men. also at this time create the worker models too. entertainers, uniforms that can change color scheme, tools held (broom radio wrench mower water pot flashlight balloon etc)
I couldn't figure out how to open the database explorer.
searching the lore db should allow you to click results and read them inline, ie if searching james 1:2 you should be able to read that whole chapter.
